description.html: In your hour of need, your enemy offered you a lifeline. Now that all of your lifelines are used, you begin to feel his power creeping over you. He offers you powers beyond what you should receive, but you delve deeper into darkness every time you accept.

sheet.description: You have made a pact with a fiend from the lower planes of existence.

description.html:
Strahd lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

description.html:
A dark power overcomes you, a reminder of the day you gave into your urges and sacrificed your final lifeline to hunt evil incarnate. An anger remains, an anger strahd allows you to draw on to "Blink".

Once per long rest, you may "Blink" as a bonus action. Blinking allows you to move up to 200ft toward a point you can see. This does not function as a teleport. You must be able to physically move to that point via running, jumping or climbing. When the combat encounter ends, you gain 1 level of exhaustion.

When you use this action, the mists of Barovia surround you and the point you are blinking to for a moment. You physically move through the space, but other creatures perceive you as dissapearing into one cloud of mist and appearing out of the other.

sheet.description: You may move up to 200ft as a bonus action, you gain a level of exhaustion

description.html:
You gain the ability to steal your own good fortune. When terrible odds show themselves, and you fall to bad luck, you can reach into the future and save your current skin.

When you fail any roll that has a set difficulty (DC, AC, or any save), you can choose to roll the lowest possible successful number instead and succeed.

However, this bad luck will return in the future, replacing your otherwise potential good fortune. Your next roll will with a set difficulty will be an automatic failure. Cosmetically, when you use this power, your tattoos flash bright gold, and shimmer till your next turn. You further feel an energy drain you mentally when you use this power, though you cannot quite explain what it is.

You may use "Futureproof" as a bonus action twice per long rest.

description.html: Starting at 10th level, you can choose one damage type when you finish a short or long rest. You gain resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature. Damage from magical weapons or silver weapons ignores this resistance.

description.html:
Starting at 14th level, when you hit a creature with an attack, you can use this feature to instantly transport the target through the lower planes. The creature disappears and hurtles through a nightmare landscape.

At the end of your next turn, the target returns to the space it previously occupied, or the nearest unoccupied space. If the target is not a fiend, it takes 10d10 psychic damage as it reels from its horrific experience.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
